reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet, and naiwa reference; rechecked native-resolution hair, eyes, mouth, collar and decoration details and independently verified parent/source/derived hashes, exact RGB identity, bilinear source-alpha mapping, corners, receipt and final-evidence/sheet bindings with read-only Python

entries.positive_observation: The derived RGBA preserves the approved parent art in full and in native detail: high bald crown with short gray side/back hair, thick dark brows, clean-shaven upper lip and chin, and no headgear or glasses. The yellow mascot retains green-ringed solid black eyes, one stern closed mouth and no human nose, ears or skin. The image-left three-quarter pose and gaze, lighting and crop remain. The dark gray-green uniform retains two silver leaf-like collar patches, silver shoulder details, pale piping, gray shirt and dark green tie in their source positions and counts. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib. The full pale gray-beige mottled backplate remains continuous through all corners and around the crown, with no frame, note, halo or replacement studio.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the derived RGBA for production. The source alpha was resized from 156x210 to 1776x2368 with BILINEAR and applied without changing any parent RGB pixel bytes. Independent read-only recomputation confirmed rgb_unchanged=true, alpha_matches_resized_source=true and the recorded resized-alpha hash. Source, resized and output corner alpha are all [251,251,255,255], and source/output alpha extrema are [251,255]. Complete white/cyan/alpha inspection shows the original near-opaque full-canvas backing with no visible holes, lost corners, working-matte ring or new exterior cutout; near-opaque internal values were not treated as defects. This is a derived alpha-repaired file, not a native transparent return.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine collar-leaf embroidery and shoulder-detail interiors cannot be transcribed exactly at 156x210. Their visible shapes, counts and placements were rechecked; no approval rests on a claim of exact unreadable heraldry.
